subject: PO issuance stalled during onboarding — spend-cap offset & SKU tagging
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jason Park <procurement@lumenix.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO issuance stalled during onboarding — spend-cap offset & SKU tagging

Hi Jason / Lumenix team,

Thanks for starting the intake — I'm reviewing the onboarding packet and hit a mismatch in our system that stopped the PO from issuing. Our intake shows Lumenix requested an initial spend cap of $250,000 (notes on the intake form), but the provisional PO the finance system created is for $25,000 and only one line item (SKU: LX-CORE). That lower cap is blocking activation in our provisioning pipeline.

Attached: the onboarding form you submitted (lumenix_onboarding_form.pdf) and the provisional PO our system currently generated (lumenix_provisional_po.csv). Can you confirm:
- Was the requested initial cap intended to be 250k or a smaller pilot amount?
- Are there multiple SKUs we should list separately (e.g., LX-CORE, LX-EDGE, LX-DEPLOY) so we can map line items?

Action requested from you: please confirm the intended initial cap and provide a one-line CSV with the desired line-item split (if any). If you want us to proceed with a provisional 200k cap while legal finishes the contract, say so and we'll route for a temporary override.

I'll loop in Connor and Karthik to make any system-side changes once we have your confirmation.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lumenix_onboarding_form.pdf (form/pdf), lumenix_provisional_po.csv (csv)

From: Jason Park <procurement@lumenix.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumenix Onboarding Team <onboarding@lumenix.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO issuance stalled during onboarding — spend-cap offset & SKU tagging

Hi Monica / team,

Thanks for the heads up — apologies for any confusion. We had requested $250,000 as the initial authorized spend (to cover Q3 usage and professional services ramp). We also intended to have three line items:
- LX-CORE (licensing) — $150,000
- LX-EDGE (edge connectors) — $60,000
- LX-DEPLOY (professional services) — $40,000

I've attached the Lumenix ratecard and an updated provisional PO CSV (lumenix_ratecard_v2.xlsx and lumenix_provisional_po.csv) with the line splits and unit prices. If Redwood needs a temporary lower cap while SOC2 review finishes, we can accept a staged activation (200k provisional + 50k pending). Please advise what you need from our side to unblock.

On a separate note, our legal team is working the Master Services Agreement (MSA) redlines; they expected the finance token to be in place for the initial provisioning.

- Jason Park
Head of Procurement, Lumenix
procurement@lumenix.com

Attachments: lumenix_ratecard_v2.xlsx (xlsx), lumenix_provisional_po.csv (csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Park <procurement@lumenix.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO issuance stalled during onboarding — spend-cap offset & SKU tagging

Monica / Connor —

Thanks Jason, that breakdown helps. Two internal notes before we action:
1) System limitation: provisional POs default to the lowest authorization bracket if the intake form field doesn’t match the budget code we use (we saw 25k generated because the intake mapped to code BUD-LOW by mismatch). I can push a manual override to set provisional spend to 200,000 immediately, but finance will need a justification ticket to move the remaining 50k from pending to active once legal returns the MSA.
2) Line items: we prefer explicit SKU rows so downstream billing and tagging are accurate. I'll create the three line items in the PO and tag each with the vendor SKU you provided. Connor, can you confirm we have the budget code mapping for LX-CORE / LX-EDGE / LX-DEPLOY? If not, we should create temporary ledger tags and reconcile later.

Jason: Monica will send an updated provisional PO reflecting the 200k provisional with the three line items. We'll add an internal note linking to the HubSpot deal (DL-7834) and to the onboarding drive folder.

I'll open the finance justification ticket (FJ-9942) after Monica posts the updated CSV — that should keep things moving and avoid a hard stall in provisioning.

Karthik
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

- Line items created: LX-CORE ($150,000), LX-EDGE ($35,000), LX-DEPLOY ($15,000). The remaining $50,000 sits in a pending reserve linked to finance ticket FJ-9942 (will be released on legal sign-off of MSA).
- HubSpot deal DL-7834 updated with the PO reference and a link to the Drive folder: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-lumenix-onboarding
